headings.heading_title: Multi-Tiered System of Support (MTSS) School Mental Health Pyramid

subheadings.text: Universal Support All Students Supports are accessible by all students focusing on mental health literacy, prevention, and a positive and inclusive school climate Peer-led health education  Mental health promotion  Teacher training and consultation  Staff wellness  Youth development activities   Social emotional learning  Positive behavior initiatives  Mindfulness  Trauma informed practices School-wide screening

Targeted Support Some Students Additional services provided to some students, and are provided in addition to universal supports  Screening, assessment & referral  Support and empowerment groups  Affinity groups  Restorative Justice circles Substance use counseling  Peer-to-peer Counseling  Social skill development

Intensive Support Few Students Targeted supports provided to students with greater needs to support behavioral, emotional, and/or mental health via specialized services providers. Provided in addition to targeted and universal supports Individual, group, and family therapy  Trauma-informed therapeutic groups Multi-system case management Crisis intervention
